Trump suggests data center companies pay community dividends

Former US President Donald Trump proposed that data center companies should pay a "dividend" to local communities to increase the popularity of their projects. He stated that these companies must also generate their own power and either return or sell any surplus energy to the community. This suggestion comes amid growing backlash against data centers in the US due to concerns over their demands on water and electricity resources.
